summary: Verified 'ONE JUMP, ONE PLATFORM LEVEL' fix. Ran all required node validation scripts (one_jump_one_level_check, level_engine_validation 24 2600, solver_sabotage_check, drop_cooldown_check) — all PASS. In-browser verified physics constants (APEX=167.23 px, MAX_RISE=172.23 px), balance config (gap easy=100, hard=114, max=128, twoLevelMargin=12), live gameplay at mobile 390x844 showed smooth level-by-level climb (0→21 m) with visible ~100-128 px spacing between consecutive platform levels, debug overlay (?debug=1) showed seed/retry/best/hazard/no-enemies lines, pink route lines rendered, no console errors, no pageerrors. Guide text contains required '2,5–3,2 m' spacing and 'satu lompatan biasa hanya mencapai satu tingkat berikutnya' / '한 번으로는 바로 위 단계까지만' strings (ID+KO).
critical_code_review_comments: Balance config shows gap.easy=100 and twoLevelMargin=12; with MAX_RISE=172.23 the minimum two-level distance observed (200 px) is safely above landable rise — good.
Solver stats: 2935 edges with 0 unreachable and 0 fallbacks across sabotage check. Validation suite over 24 seeds × 2600 m beats produced 0 simFail, 0 fallbacks, 0 retries, 25,359 levelChecks passed.
Guide i18n strings for ID and KO both describe the new rule — well localized.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All ONE-JUMP-ONE-LEVEL validation infra is green. Node scripts: one_jump_one_level_check.mjs prints 'PASS' (levelSkips=0, minTwoLevelDy=200px vs legacy 144px). level_engine_validation.mjs 24 2600 ~60-90s prints 'ALL CHECKS PASSED'. Dismiss tutorial modal via data-testid='tutorial-ready' button; debug overlay via ?debug=1 query. Game routes are SPA #main/#guide/#shop/#missions.
rca of the issue: Legacy platform gaps (72-76 px) allowed sum of two gaps (~152 px) to fall below jump apex (167 px), letting a single jump skip a level. Fix retuned balance.gap to easy=100/hard=114/max=128 with twoLevelMargin=12 and added twoLevelOk + dead-end validation in solver/director, enemy support tile offset=0. Verified: min two-level distance now 200 px > MAX_RISE 172.23 px — second level above is unreachable by a normal jump.
